scope: Reconcile Kinetic, Energy, and AMM point-defense architecture, then oversweep all balance-relevant PDS parameters and synthesize coherent TL1-TL9 PDS ladders against the native-accepted CP153 main-weapon environment.

pdsArchitecture.reactionCapacity: per-turn pool of interception attempts; attempts remain committed to the first arriving Flight until it is destroyed or its legal engagement windows are exhausted, after which unused RC may spill to later Flights
pdsArchitecture.terminalWindows: Kinetic and Energy PDS remain local same-hex defenses with at most two terminal opportunities: terminal entry and immediately before terminal attack
pdsArchitecture.ammRc3: AMM RC3 is qualitatively different: one range-1 pre-terminal opportunity plus the two local terminal windows; no Kinetic or Energy range-1/RC3 capability is enabled
pdsArchitecture.ammRangeOneFlightSemantics: the range-1 AMM opportunity attacks the magazine Flight before terminal Swarmer subflights are individually exposed; a miss commits remaining RC to that first Flight's terminal windows
pdsArchitecture.energyIdentity: Energy PDS is ammunition-free and may trade Tactical Power for RC2; candidate states include safe RC2 and overcharged RC2 where the extra reaction adds persistent PDS Strain only when that extra reaction is actually fired
pdsArchitecture.forcedOverloadPolicy: normal research AI is safe-only; once an overcharged Energy PDS reaches its Strain Limit it falls back to a legal safe readiness state rather than treating Forced Overload as routine defense
pdsArchitecture.singleArrivalScope: current substantive balance remains based on the accepted single-arriving-Flight cadence; simultaneous multi-Flight and cross-target range-1 benefits are preserved as future mechanics/integration validation rather than invented balance weight

pdsClosureDesign.broadContextDesign: every attacker x defender-main x stratum combination at each TL, with all five resource ensembles Latin-rotated across the cells; full resource crossing is reserved for deep confirmation
pdsClosureDesign.deepContextDesign: full attacker x defender-main x six-stratum x five-resource crossing at every TL
pdsClosureDesign.attackerMains: GP M2, GP M3, and Swarmer SW2 where unlocked
pdsClosureDesign.defenderMains: K1, E7, GP M2, and Swarmer SW2 where unlocked
pdsClosureDesign.heldFixed: CP153 K1/E7/M2-or-M3/SW2 mains, current Hull/Shield/Armor/DEF/RES, current AUX, EW/Sensor, movement/cadence, and provisional Reactor/TP supply
pdsClosureDesign.spacePolicy: PDS Space remains current during this closure; Space/AUX opportunity-cost retuning belongs to the subsequent AUX lifetime pass

wholeLadderSynthesis.kineticCoherence: base chance and RC may hold or improve; RC never regresses; no RC3/range-1
wholeLadderSynthesis.energyCoherence: base chance and RC may hold or improve; overcharged RC2 may mature into safe RC2 but safe RC2 does not regress to strain-requiring RC2
wholeLadderSynthesis.ammCoherence: base chance and RC may hold or improve; RC3 is range-1 architecture and, once acquired, does not regress
wholeLadderSynthesis.selection: whole-ladder beam synthesis from actually tested candidates; preserve distinct RC/Strain/range-1 trajectories before filling duplicate-equivalent slots

deferred: production C# and active Concept/numerical-matrix promotion
